Messages.Author: Magnus
Messages.Body:
Two questions which came up in my playgroup in the last weeks:

First question :
When you call a political referendum, you theoretically can discard a
political card from your hand to gain a vote, but only *one* per
referendum. As you are the acting minion however, you already *have*
played a political card, i.e. the one with which you called the
referendum. Does that mean that you cannot discard another political
card from your hand to get a vote, or not ?

Second question :
Tyler diablerizes Arika, and theoretically gains ( or should that be
"loses" ?) one generation. However in my deck there are no skill cards
she could use, as I only put CEL and POT skill cards into it, and she
already has both at superior. Is she considered to have gained
capacity 10 even without me having put a skill card on her ?

Thanks! :)

Magnus

Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:
Magnus wrote:
> Two questions which came up in my playgroup in the last weeks:
>
> First question :
> When you call a political referendum, you theoretically can discard a
> political card from your hand to gain a vote, but only *one* per
> referendum. As you are the acting minion however, you already *have*
> played a political card, i.e. the one with which you called the
> referendum. Does that mean that you cannot discard another political
> card from your hand to get a vote, or not ?

Right, the acting minion's methuselah cannot gain another political card.

> Second question :
> Tyler diablerizes Arika, and theoretically gains ( or should that be
> "loses" ?) one generation. However in my deck there are no skill cards
> she could use, as I only put CEL and POT skill cards into it, and she
> already has both at superior. Is she considered to have gained
> capacity 10 even without me having put a skill card on her ?

No. The vampire's capacity will only increase due to the cardtext on the
discipline card, it does not happen due to the diablerie itself.

Flux

vote.
